summary.en: The Tablighi Ijtema near Lahore, held in two phases. Plan your way in and out, and meet at fixed places.

detail.en: Save your camp or block as a meeting point as soon as you arrive.
Traffic police set up numbered parking stands. Note yours and save it.
The station has extra staff and a medical camp during the Ijtema.

dos.en: Plan your trip home before the closing dua: roads in Raiwind close and traffic runs one way toward Lahore.
Park only in the official parking stands.
Rescue 1122 has medical teams at the Ijtema. Note where the nearest one is.
Find the exits and a second way out as soon as you arrive.
In a dense crowd, keep your hands up near your chest to protect your breathing.

donts.en: Don't park outside the stands or on roads kept clear for emergency vehicles.
Don't try to leave with the whole crowd right after the dua if you can wait.
Don't push against the flow of a crowd, and don't stop or sit down in it.

detail.en: The Ijtema is held in two phases about a week apart, usually in November. Each ends with a collective dua.
In recent years extra trains have stopped at Raiwind, and in 2025 the Punjab government ran an electric bus from Lahore railway station and the airport. Check this year's arrangements.

meaning.en: I am looking for my family

phrasebook.phrase: میں اپنے گھر والوں کو ڈھونڈ رہا ہوں
phrasebook.transliteration: main apne ghar walon ko dhoond raha hoon

checklist.en: Every group member has the app, has joined the group and has filled in their emergency card.
Camp or block and parking stand saved as meeting points.
A plan for the trip home after the closing dua.
